name: Snezhnaya: Snow Wings
description:
Namecard style.
Fairy tales say that every snowflake is actually a downy feather shed from the vast snow wings that blot out the sky over the continent's eastern reaches. Everyone knows that fairy tales have their share of wild imaginings, but perhaps there's a grain of truth hidden in them.
source: Reward for completing all achievements under "Snezhnaya: Sacred City of Ice and Pale Star (II)"
